task.title: Post-bulk-load e2e reconciliation: restore a green suite in some mode
task.description: Filed from the P6-060 session (2026-08-11) — the umbrella the skill's known-red-baseline note points at. The full-catalog bulk load (116,695 printings vs the 2,976-card POC subset the suite grew up on) broke the e2e suite's world-assumptions in every mode: serial (--workers=1, 12.4m) is 239/259 with ~13 DETERMINISTIC expectation-drift failures across 9 files (all-cards quick search, catalog paging, filter-rail serialization, card-detail touch tiles, my-root mobile rows/scroll, destination-picker, collection-undo-restore, states, collection-tree-manage — search results, counts and layouts that assumed the small catalog), plus the fixture-pool class (WB-01KZMVA2Y1: batch-move 4, command-palette 3 — their limit-N unowned-card pool math changed under the 40x catalog). Parallel additionally hits the contention class (WB-01KZRZ0TT7). Scope of THIS task: fix the ~13 deterministic drifts properly — prefer catalog-size-agnostic expectations (derive expected values from API reads, not hardcoded counts/results) over pinning new magic numbers that break at the next catalog change; coordinate with the fixture-pool task where the fix overlaps. Acceptance: one full serial pass 100% green (minus explicitly-@flaky-quarantined tests), the e2e-suite skill's known-red-baseline note deleted, and the per-file drift list in specs/ui-work-loop.md Findings updated with what each fix was. Evidence: scratchpad logs recorded in the P6-060 Findings entry; failure lists reproducible via --workers=1.
